description: NaCaGaSi₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.91 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.76 Å. Ga is bonded to four O atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.87 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent GaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent GaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.67 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ca, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms.
